# Weyland-Yutani
[bold]Weyland-Yutani[/bold], known as "the Company", is the dominant megacorporation in human space. It was born from the merger of the British Weyland Corp and the Japanese Yutani Corporation, and led humanity's first terraforming of the Moon. Its slogan is "Building Better Worlds."
The Company makes almost everything: weapons, synthetic humans, spaceships, computers, terraforming equipment and household goods, along with shipping and other ventures. It funds and runs colonies across the frontier, and its interests don't always line up with the governments around it. Rumors persist of research it keeps hidden even from its partners.
## History - The merger gave the new company a vast workforce, a wealth of expertise and the financial and political backing of several of Earth's governments, all eager to grow their economies. - It expanded rapidly into medicine, armaments, rocketry and more, until it was the largest and most widespread corporation on Earth, holding contracts with militaries and governments of every nation. Its best and most valuable services it kept for the [textlink="Three World Empire" link="CMUGuideLoreTWE"]. - Its aggressive push into terraforming new colonial worlds won it rights and privileges from the United States government, among them a close relationship with the Colonial Marines. - After the Sol Campaign and Operation Canton, the Company emerged as a power on par with the nations themselves.
## Influence - Its reach runs deep into the militaries of the great powers. Pro-Company officers in the Colonial Marines, nicknamed [bold]"Songbirds"[/bold], quietly look after its interests. - Rumor has it that congressmen in the UA and members of the TWE parliament take Company bribes, letting it steer their militaries and economies toward its own ends. - Many Colonial Marine ships have vanished while supporting Company colonies at the request of officers in the Company's pocket. Clashes between Marines and Company forces have broken out more than once, and the worst of them, which left dozens dead on both sides, was kept out of the news.
## Divisions The Company is split into divisions, each with its own chain of executives, managers and directors. - [bold]Special Services[/bold]: sales, transportation, food, employment and everything that falls to no one else. - [bold]Corporate Relations[/bold]: keeps other factions friendly, through "gifts" or by quietly tipping them off, and keeps the Company's secrets out of government hands. - [bold]Communications[/bold]: keeps every Company facility in contact, and is the first to notice when one goes quiet. - [bold]PMC Dispatch[/bold]: sends PMC teams where they are needed, whether for an escort, securing data or dealing with a problem. - [bold]Research and Development[/bold]: research, experiments and anything that might turn a profit, including escaped specimens and unusual chemicals. - [bold]Economics[/bold]: trade between factions, by the books or otherwise. - [bold]Personal Protection[/bold]: close protection for the Company's own people.
## Relations - [textlink="Three World Empire" link="CMUGuideLoreTWE"]: the Company's closest partner and its birthplace. Its board and CEO swear fealty to the Emperor, and the board has more than once been summoned to explain itself when its dealings strained ties with the UA. - [textlink="United Americas" link="CMUGuideLoreUA"]: its second largest customer. The Colonial Marines are largely armed and equipped with Company designs, and in return must take on Company requests. The Company sees the Marines as a valuable but disposable asset, and the missing personnel and ships have left the relationship strained and increasingly hostile. - [textlink="Union of Progressive Peoples" link="CMUGuideLoreUPP"]: despite everything, the Company sells it terraforming, survey and mining equipment, and has bought colonies the UPP no longer wants to maintain. Rumors that it supplies the UPP with illegal combat synthetics are dismissed by executives as a smear. - [textlink="Colonial Liberation Front" link="CMUGuideLoreCLF"]: openly hostile. The CLF targets Company colonies above all others, and the Company answers with PMC patrols around its assets and strikes against CLF leadership.
## Forces - [textlink="Weyland-Yutani PMC" link="CMUGuideLoreWYPMC"], the "Whiteshields": the Company's own soldiers, guarding its facilities and handling security and containment. Colonial governments often hire them because they get the job done faster than the local military. - [bold]Weyland-Yutani Corporate Security[/bold], known by many as [bold]"mall cops"[/bold] or [bold]"oranges"[/bold] are the Company's primary security presence on many of its colonies and facilities. Usually recruited and organized locally, it protects Company personnel, property and interests and keeps order in Weyland-Yutani settlements. On Company-owned colonies they commonly serve as the de facto police force, handling everything from routine patrols and criminal investigations to riot control and the protection of sensitive corporate sites.
